title: Fix a refused probe
description: A touch panel's SNMP agent refused the endpoint's community, so the node stopped asking. Read why, point the endpoint at the right community, and watch the refusal lift.

steps.caption: This place's system. Its touch panel fills the touch-control role, and a node collects it.
Expand it to the component's view, where collection is read.
Its SNMP endpoint holds no session, yet it reads refused, in the agent's words. The node sends no more gets, so nothing hammers it.
Open the endpoint. The ladder shows the ping answering and the community held.
The community is one of the endpoint's inputs, edited in place.
Select the secret it names now.
Name the secret holding the community the agent answers.
Save. What the endpoint connects with changed, so the refusal no longer holds.
The node asks again at its next check-in, the agent answers the community, and the refusal is gone.
